subject: psychology
topic: Strict parenting is more strongly linked to anxiety than to aggression
angle: While authoritarian and harsh control are linked to internalizing symptoms, children also show increased problems when they perceive their parents as having dissimilar parenting styles.
title: The Weight of Parental Control

hooks.text: Is strict parenting the only path to behavior problems?
You assume strictness causes aggression. The evidence links it to internal distress.
You are enforcing a rule that might be causing anxiety.
A child stands between two different sets of rules.

reveal.headline: Strict parenting is linked to internalizing symptoms.
reveal.body: Harsh control and psychological control are positively associated with adolescent anxiety, depression, and suicidal ideation. These findings are mixed and come from different theoretical backgrounds.

explain.headline: The source of the problem is complex.
explain.body: Authoritarian parenting predicts behavior problems. However, permissive parenting is also linked to internalizing issues. Children also show more problems when they perceive parents have dissimilar styles.

matters.headline: Consistency matters more than intensity.
matters.body: That may be why the perception of a united front is significant. When parents have dissimilar styles, children show increased problems. The pressure of harsh control adds another layer of internal distress.

example.headline: A kitchen at 7:00 am.
example.body: You watch your parents give different instructions to your child. One uses a firm tone. The other is lenient. The child stands between them, silent.

question.headline: Whose rules are your child actually following?

verdict: The evidence shows that strict and harsh parenting styles are linked to internalizing symptoms, but it also highlights that permissive parenting and parental dissimilarity contribute to these problems.
caveat: The reported findings are inconsistent and the studies in question have been conducted from different theoretical backgrounds.
caption:
Strict parenting is linked to internalizing symptoms like anxiety and depression.

Research shows that authoritarian styles, permissive styles, and parental dissimilarity all contribute to behavior problems. These findings are mixed and come from different theoretical backgrounds.

How do you see the balance between control and consistency in your own home?
